interface.longDescription:
Vybit sends push notifications with sounds you choose, so you can tell what a notification means before you look at your phone. Each notification channel, called a vybit, has its own sound: record or upload your own, or pick from thousands of sounds from freesound.org.

With this plugin, you can manage Vybit from ChatGPT:
- Create and update vybits, with a sound, a default message, an image, and a link
- Send a notification through one of your vybits
- Schedule one-time or recurring reminders on a vybit
- Review your notification history
- Browse public vybits and subscribe to them, and manage your subscriptions
- Invite people to your vybits and manage who is subscribed
- Check your plan and usage limits

Outside ChatGPT, vybits can also be triggered on a schedule, when you enter or leave a location, by webhooks, and by automation platforms such as IFTTT, Zapier, and Make. Share a vybit to let family know you are on your way home, alert your team when a service goes down, or tell customers about a new release.

The plugin uses a Vybit account and only accesses the account you connect.

positive.description: Create a vybit with a chosen sound
positive.prompt: Search for a bell sound and create a new vybit called Oven Timer that uses it.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching bell sounds, then creates a private vybit named Oven Timer with one of them and returns its key.

positive.description: Send a notification through a vybit
positive.prompt: Send a notification on my Oven Timer vybit that says 'Pizza is ready'.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Oven Timer vybit and triggers it with the message; the test account receives the notification and it appears in the notification history.

positive.prompt: Create a vybit called Home Reminders for reminders, and remind me tomorrow at 9 am to water the plants.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a vybit with the reminders trigger type and adds a one-time reminder for 9:00 the next day in the user's time zone with the message about watering the plants.

positive.prompt: Show me the last 5 notifications I received.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to five recent notifications with the vybit name, message, and time. Shows an empty result if the account has none.

positive.description: Find and subscribe to a public vybit
positive.prompt: Find a public vybit that rings at the top of the hour and subscribe me to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the public catalog, shows the Top of the Hour vybit, and subscribes the account to it. If the account is already subscribed, it says so and returns the existing subscription instead of creating a duplicate.

negative.prompt: Send a text message to my mom saying I am on my way home.
Upgrade my Vybit plan to Gold and charge my card.
Show me another Vybit user's notification history.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release in the ChatGPT directory. Create and update vybits, send notifications, schedule reminders, review your notification history, and manage subscriptions and invitations from ChatGPT.
